body:
INSTAGRAM
What my first 33 TikToks taught me, with real numbers: show the product, and don't stop posting.

16,066 views across 33 videos. 487 average, 325 median, 32 followers (Metricool, 17 Aug to 4 Oct).
Videos with the app on screen landed around 700. Advice with nothing to look at sat around 315.
Then I stopped posting on 22 September and everything went flat.

I'm posting daily again. Follow @manrajtalks and hold me to it.
Free weekly guide: Life With AI, link in bio.
Tools mentioned: Metricool https://metricool.com · Wispr Flow https://wisprflow.ai

TIKTOK
